description: A platform-independent file lock for Python.

latest_release.body: ### Bug fixes - Contended `FileLock` and `SoftFileLock` acquisitions now raise `Timeout` when elapsed time reaches the requested timeout. A clock that landed exactly on the deadline previously left a waiter retrying with zero-length sleeps indefinitely ([#922](https://github.com/tox-dev/filelock/pull/922)) by @gaborbernat. ### Packaging - Every wheel now carries a [PEP 770](https://peps.python.org/pep-0770/) CycloneDX SBOM in its `.dist-info/sboms` directory, written at build time by [python-sbom](https://github.com/tox-dev/python-sbom) ([#921](https://github.com/tox-dev/filelock/pull/921)) by @gaborbernat. [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/filelock/4.2.10/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/filelock/compare/4.2.9...4.2.10)
